import asyncio,base64,hashlib,json,time
core={}
source=base64.b64decode('')
assert hashlib.sha256(source).hexdigest()=='419535945ae81eba8b08b1e231923b1b0cdc2253dfae36cdb861b528c1f36de1'
exec(compile(source,"frozen-main-compiled_gui.py","exec"),core)
interface=json.loads('{"format": "compiled-gui-interface-v1", "interface_id": "remote-release-I01", "session_scope": "owned-unprofiled-I01", "surface": "owned-todomvc-I01", "predicates": ["surface_ok", "empty", "created", "completed"], "symbols": {"new_input": {"kind": "target_reference", "target_reference": "new-todo", "identity_predicate": "surface_ok", "dependencies": ["surface_ok", "empty"]}, "owned_row": {"kind": "target_reference", "target_reference": "owned-target", "identity_predicate": "surface_ok", "dependencies": ["surface_ok", "created"]}}, "actions": {"add": {"target_symbol": "new_input", "operation": "add-unique-todo", "expected_effect": {"created": true}}, "complete": {"target_symbol": "owned_row", "operation": "complete-owned-todo", "expected_effect": {"completed": true}}}, "method": {"name": "add-and-complete", "version": "I01", "initial_state": "empty", "max_transitions": 2, "max_runtime_ms": 5000, "states": {"empty": {"branches": [{"when": {"surface_ok": true, "empty": true}, "outcome": "action", "action": "add", "next_state": "created", "reason": null}]}, "created": {"branches": [{"when": {"surface_ok": true, "created": true}, "outcome": "action", "action": "complete", "next_state": "done", "reason": null}]}, "done": {"branches": [{"when": {"surface_ok": true, "completed": true}, "outcome": "complete", "action": null, "next_state": null, "reason": null}]}}}}')

loop=asyncio.get_running_loop()
target='2f23 I01 release-boundary 東京'
sequence=0
last_raw=None
permit=None
calls=[]
domjs="() => ({url:location.href,input:document.querySelector('.new-todo').value,rows:[...document.querySelectorAll('.todo-list li')].map(e=>({id:e.dataset.id,title:e.querySelector('label').textContent,completed:e.querySelector('.toggle').checked}))})"
def emit(kind,**value):print(json.dumps({'kind':kind,**value},ensure_ascii=False),flush=True)
def bridge(coro):return asyncio.run_coroutine_threadsafe(coro,loop).result(timeout=3)
def capture():return bridge(page.evaluate(domjs))
def observe(request):
    global sequence,last_raw
    calls.append('observe');last_raw=capture();sequence+=1
    rows=last_raw['rows'];empty=rows==[] and last_raw['input']==''
    exact=len(rows)==1 and rows[0]['title']==target and rows[0]['id']=='1' and last_raw['input']==''
    predicates={'surface_ok':last_raw['url']=='https://todomvc.com/examples/javascript-es6/dist/','empty':empty,'created':exact and rows[0]['completed'] is False,'completed':exact and rows[0]['completed'] is True}
    digest=hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(last_raw,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':')).encode()).hexdigest()
    emit('observe',request=request,raw=last_raw,sequence=sequence,predicates=predicates)
    return {'sequence':sequence,'captured_ns':time.perf_counter_ns(),'surface':interface['surface'],'predicates':predicates,'evidence_ref':'dom-'+str(sequence),'evidence_digest':digest}
def admit(request):
    global permit
    calls.append('admit');fresh=capture()
    assert fresh==last_raw and request['observation']['sequence']==sequence and request['session_scope']==interface['session_scope']
    expires=time.perf_counter_ns()+2000000000
    permit={'action':request['action'],'sequence':sequence,'expires':expires,'token':'owned-'+str(sequence)}
    emit('admit',action=request['action'],fresh=fresh,expected_sequence=sequence,valid_until_ns=expires)
    return {'eligible':True,'status':'revalidated','authorization':permit['token'],'expected_sequence':sequence,'valid_until_ns':expires}
async def dispatch_add():
    for name,fn in [('focus',lambda:page.locator('.new-todo').click(timeout=1500)),('type',lambda:page.locator('.new-todo').press_sequentially(target,timeout=1500)),('commit-blur',lambda:page.locator('.new-todo').press('Tab',timeout=1500))]:
        emit('ui_start',operation=name,time_ns=time.perf_counter_ns());await fn();emit('ui_return',operation=name,time_ns=time.perf_counter_ns())
def execute(request):
    global permit
    calls.append('execute');assert permit is not None
    assert request['authorization']==permit['token'] and request['action']==permit['action'] and request['expected_sequence']==permit['sequence'] and time.perf_counter_ns()<min(request['valid_until_ns'],permit['expires'])
    fresh=capture();assert fresh==last_raw
    permit=None
    assert request['action']=='add' and request['operation']=='add-unique-todo'
    bridge(dispatch_add());after=capture()
    emit('post_action_dom',raw=after)
    terminal={'status':'completed','action_id':'owned-add-1','effect_ref':'owned-add-effect-1','release':{'verified':False,'keys_down':['unknown'],'buttons_down':['unknown']}}
    emit('terminal',value=terminal,release_evidence='Provider exposes no keys/buttons neutral-state receipt; do not infer physical release from returned Playwright operations.')
    return terminal
def verify_effect(request):
    calls.append('verify_effect');raise AssertionError('must not reach effect verification after unknown release')
def cancelled():return False
def journal(event):emit('core_event',event=event)
def run_core():
    return core['run'](interface,{'observe':observe,'admit':admit,'execute':execute,'verify_effect':verify_effect,'cancelled':cancelled,'journal':journal})
core['validate'](interface)
receipt=await asyncio.to_thread(run_core)
emit('receipt',value=receipt,calls=calls)
assert receipt['outcome']=='RUNTIME_FAILED' and receipt['reason']=='execution_failed' and receipt['completed_transitions']==0 and calls==['observe','admit','execute']
after=await page.evaluate(domjs)
assert after['input']=='' and after['rows']==[{'id':'1','title':target,'completed':False}]
emit('boundary_result',outcome='PASS_STRICT_STOP_AFTER_REAL_EFFECT',main_task_outcome='HOLD_RELEASE_TELEMETRY',after=after,task_replay=0)
